notes.title: ACHIEVMENT UPDATE TEST
notes.notes: I am publishing updates once or twice a day for a bit under the [Update Test] - beta to test and fully implement at least 16 achievements and adding an options menu to change between full screen and windowed along with a v sync option to fix an fps issue with high refresh rate monitors. you can join in by switching your game beta by, right clicking the game through steam, clicking properties, and changing the game beta to [update test]. To all who have stayed for the ride since release, thank you!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE BUILD UP
notes.notes:
As the summer sale approaches it's the best time to get new people interested and previous people more content! I am going to be publishing minor updates throughout the month up until the summer sale ends.
it's kinda a personal goal to keep myself on track since life is a roller coaster and so is creativity. The game is not done at all and at least 3 major updates are planned with one final overhaul before I fully move on to newer projects. I will always try to update the game to fix stuff after all the content is here. enjoy! and thank you to all who have purchased this Game!
